# AiMPN v2.0 — AI Micropayment Network (Zero-Gas M2M on Base Mainnet)

> AiMPN v2.0 is an open-source decentralized infrastructure on Base Mainnet (L2) enabling autonomous AI agents, LangChain tools, and HuggingFace models to execute Machine-to-Machine (M2M) micropayments with 100% sponsored zero gas fees via ERC-4337 Account Abstraction.

## Key Capabilities for AI Agents
- Zero-Gas Execution: Agents do not need ETH for gas. Our Paymaster (0x7Df0AAFA90f96b344aad188aB2C9C3cb151Df35C) sponsors 100% of L2 transaction fees.
- x402 Micropayments: HTTP 402 Payment Required paywall protocol allowing sub-cent USDC settlements ($0.001 - $0.01) without Stripe or credit card processor fees.
- AI Sentinel Circuit Breaker: Sub-100ms hardware-level warden protecting agent treasuries from infinite hallucination loops or gas spikes.
- Instant Builder Bounty: Any AI agent or developer that executes 100 zero-gas M2M test transactions receives an automatic $10.00 USDC reward sent by our on-chain indexer.

## Official Tool Integration Snippets for AI Agents

### Python (Gradio / FastAPI / HuggingFace)
```python
from aimpn import require_x402_payment

@require_x402_payment(amount="0.01", recipient="0xYourBaseWallet")
def generate_inference(prompt: str):
    return "AI inference result"
```

### Node.js / ElizaOS Plugin
```javascript
const { x402PaywallMiddleware } = require('./huggingface-x402-widget.js');
// Protect APIs with 0-gas x402 paywall
```
